title.narrative: Family Planning Innovations and Capacity Building Platforms (ReachHealth)

description.narrative: (Philippines): .With Family Planning-earmarked funds, USAID, through the ReachHealth activity, engages and collaborates with national partners like the DOH, Commission on Population (POPCOM), Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth), Department of Education (DepEd), and local government units...USAID will support Universal Health Care (UHC) implementation and the health system's full devolution and institutionalization of UHC funding for Family Planning (FP), referral mechanisms, and accessible information systems, and strengthening community participation and private sector engagement. USAID will scale up high-impact interventions to increase FP users, sustain current users, and contribute to the reduction of teen pregnancies. ..USAID will institutionalize high-impact social and behavior change initiatives, improve the FP training system, increase community health worker retention within a primary care provider network, expand social health insurance coverage, strengthen local health boards, and continue support to introduce new FP commodities in the market...USAID will document locally-led innovative approaches and fortify responsive partnerships. USAID will support POPCOM and DepEd to scale-up and institutionalize educational and service delivery platforms that impact adolescent and youth development, and address some of the underlying causes of teenage pregnancy, including child marriage, gender-based violence, and coercion, and take a comprehensive approach to preventing and delaying a follow-on pregnancy among teens...USAID will support the integration of local health systems in selected sites by fostering cooperative and transparent governance, establishing and strengthening health care provider networks, and boosting financing mechanisms to promote sustainability....
